output:
  html_document: default

# 00. SETUP
```{r}
################################################################################
# 00. SETUP
################################################################################

# Data management
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

# Statistics
library(metafor)

# Export
library(writexl)

# Options
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"), scipen = 999)
theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 14))
set.seed(1234)
```

# 01. DATA CLEANING
```{r}
################################################################################
# 01. DATA CLEANING
################################################################################

# Raw data
df_raw <- read_excel("03_psyexcl_raw.xlsx", guess_max = 200000)
print(nrow(df_raw))

# Phrases that contain psychiatric words but are not psychiatric conditions
pattern_false_positive <- paste0(
  "bone marrow depression|marrow depression|respiratory depression|ventilatory depression|",
  "st[- ]segment depression|st depression|depression of (the )?st|myelodepression|",
  "cns depress\\w*|central nervous system depress\\w*|immunodepress\\w*|",
  "cardiac depression|myocardial depression|neuromuscular depression|",
  "anti-?depress\\w*|depressants?\\b|anti-?psychotic\\w*"
)

# Psychiatric exclusion categories
pattern_general <- paste0(
  "psychiatr|mental (illness|disorder|disease|health (condition|disorder|problem|illness))|",
  "mentally ill|psychological (disorder|illness|condition)|emotional disorder|neuropsychiatr"
)
pattern_depression <- "depress(ion|ive|ed)"
pattern_suicidality <- "suicid"
pattern_psychosis <- "psychos[ie]s|psychotic|schizophreni|bipolar|manic|\\bmania\\b"
pattern_substance <- paste0(
  "(alcohol|drug|substance|opioid|opiate|narcotic|cocaine|cannabis|marijuana|amphetamine|benzodiazepine)s?",
  "\\s+(abuse|dependen\\w*|addict\\w*|use disorder|misuse)|",
  "alcoholism|addiction|substance use|illicit drug|chemical dependen"
)
pattern_other <- paste0(
  "anxiety disorder|eating disorder|anorexia nervosa|bulimi|\\bptsd\\b|",
  "post-?traumatic stress|personality disorder|obsessive|panic disorder"
)
pattern_any <- paste(
  pattern_general, pattern_depression, pattern_suicidality,
  pattern_psychosis, pattern_substance, pattern_other,
  sep = "|"
)

# Rename, recode, derive
df_clean <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    start_year = as.numeric(str_sub(start_date, 1, 4)),
    phase = case_when(
      phases == "PHASE1|PHASE2" ~ "Phase 1/2",
      phases == "PHASE2" ~ "Phase 2",
      phases == "PHASE2|PHASE3" ~ "Phase 2/3",
      phases == "PHASE3" ~ "Phase 3",
      phases == "PHASE4" ~ "Phase 4",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sponsor_class = case_when(
      lead_sponsor_class == "INDUSTRY" ~ "Industry",
      lead_sponsor_class %in% c("NIH", "FED", "OTHER_GOV") ~ "Government",
      !is.na(lead_sponsor_class) ~ "Other",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    sponsor_industry = as.numeric(sponsor_class == "Industry"),
    mesh_all = paste(replace_na(mesh_terms, ""), replace_na(mesh_ancestors, ""), sep = "|"),
    psychiatric_or_neuro_trial = str_detect(mesh_all, "Mental Disorders|Nervous System Diseases"),
    has_mesh = !is.na(mesh_terms) & mesh_terms != "",
    area = case_when(
      str_detect(mesh_all, "Neoplasms") ~ "Oncology",
      str_detect(mesh_all, "Cardiovascular Diseases") ~ "Cardiovascular",
      str_detect(mesh_all, "Nutritional and Metabolic Diseases|Endocrine System Diseases") ~ "Metabolic/endocrine",
      str_detect(mesh_all, "Infections") ~ "Infectious",
      str_detect(mesh_all, "Respiratory Tract Diseases") ~ "Respiratory",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    us_site = as.numeric(str_detect(replace_na(countries, ""), "United States")),
    completed = as.numeric(overall_status == "COMPLETED"),
    healthy_volunteers = as.numeric(healthy_volunteers == "TRUE" | healthy_volunteers == TRUE),
    exclusion_text = str_match(
      str_to_lower(eligibility_criteria),
      "exclusion(?:\\s+criteria)?\\s*[:\\-]?([\\s\\S]*)$"
    )[, 2],
    exclusion_text_clean = str_replace_all(exclusion_text, pattern_false_positive, " "),
    excl_general = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_general)),
    excl_depression = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_depression)),
    excl_suicidality = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_suicidality)),
    excl_psychosis = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_psychosis)),
    excl_substance = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_substance)),
    excl_other = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_other)),
    any_psych = as.numeric(str_detect(exclusion_text_clean, pattern_any))
  )

print(nrow(df_clean))

# Study-wide exclusion 1: psychiatric or neurological trials
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!psychiatric_or_neuro_trial)
print(nrow(df_clean))

# Study-wide exclusion 2: no MeSH condition terms
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  filter(has_mesh)
print(nrow(df_clean))

# Study-wide exclusion 3: no separable exclusion section
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(exclusion_text), str_length(exclusion_text) >= 20)
print(nrow(df_clean))

# Study-wide exclusion 4: missing model covariates
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_year), !is.na(phase), !is.na(sponsor_class))
print(nrow(df_clean))

# Keep analysis columns
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  select(
    nct_id, brief_title, start_year, phase, sponsor_class, sponsor_industry,
    area, us_site, completed, healthy_volunteers, enrollment, overall_status,
    excl_general, excl_depression, excl_suicidality, excl_psychosis,
    excl_substance, excl_other, any_psych, exclusion_text
  )

# Results raw data
df_status <- read_excel("03_psyexcl_status_raw.xlsx")
df_flow <- read_excel("03_psyexcl_results_flow_raw.xlsx")
df_groups <- read_excel("03_psyexcl_results_groups_raw.xlsx")
df_psych_ae <- read_excel("03_psyexcl_results_psych_ae_raw.xlsx")
df_arms <- read_excel("03_psyexcl_results_arms_raw.xlsx")

# Psychiatric adverse events per group (max over terms = lower bound; sum = upper bound)
df_group_psych <- df_psych_ae %>%
  filter(!is.na(num_affected)) %>%
  group_by(nct_id, group_id) %>%
  summarise(
    psych_max = max(num_affected, na.rm = TRUE),
    psych_sum = sum(num_affected, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Group-level adverse events with registered arm type
df_groups_clean <- df_groups %>%
  mutate(title_key = str_squish(str_to_lower(group_title))) %>%
  left_join(df_group_psych, by = c("nct_id", "group_id")) %>%
  left_join(
    df_arms %>%
      mutate(title_key = str_squish(str_to_lower(arm_label))) %>%
      distinct(nct_id, title_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
      select(nct_id, title_key, arm_type),
    by = c("nct_id", "title_key" = "title_key")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    psych_max = replace_na(psych_max, 0),
    psych_sum = replace_na(psych_sum, 0),
    at_risk = pmax(serious_at_risk, other_at_risk, na.rm = TRUE),
    title_lower = str_to_lower(group_title),
    control_inactive = arm_type %in% c("PLACEBO_COMPARATOR", "SHAM_COMPARATOR", "NO_INTERVENTION") |
      (is.na(arm_type) & str_detect(title_lower, "placebo|sham|vehicle|no treatment|no intervention|usual care|standard care|standard of care")),
    control_active = !control_inactive & arm_type %in% c("ACTIVE_COMPARATOR"),
    role = case_when(
      control_inactive ~ "control_inactive",
      control_active ~ "control_active",
      TRUE ~ "experimental"
    )
  )

# Trial-level adverse-event flags
df_trial_ae <- df_groups_clean %>%
  group_by(nct_id) %>%
  summarise(
    has_ae_results = 1,
    any_psych_ae_reported = as.numeric(any(psych_max > 0))
  )

# Add stop reason, design, participant flow and adverse-event flags to trials
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  left_join(df_status, by = "nct_id") %>%
  left_join(df_flow, by = "nct_id") %>%
  left_join(df_trial_ae, by = "nct_id") %>%
  mutate(
    has_ae_results = replace_na(has_ae_results, 0),
    stopped_low_accrual = as.numeric(
      overall_status %in% c("TERMINATED", "WITHDRAWN", "SUSPENDED") &
        str_detect(str_to_lower(replace_na(why_stopped, "")), "accru|enrol|recruit")
    ),
    flow_dropped = flow_started - flow_completed
  )

# Harm data: randomized 2-group trials, 1 experimental arm vs 1 control arm
df_harm <- df_groups_clean %>%
  group_by(nct_id) %>%
  filter(n() == 2, sum(role == "experimental") == 1, sum(role != "experimental") == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(arm = if_else(role == "experimental", "exp", "ctl")) %>%
  group_by(nct_id) %>%
  mutate(control_type = role[arm == "ctl"]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(nct_id, arm, control_type, psych_max, psych_sum, serious_affected, deaths_affected, at_risk) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = arm, values_from = c(psych_max, psych_sum, serious_affected, deaths_affected, at_risk)) %>%
  inner_join(
    df_clean %>%
      filter(allocation == "RANDOMIZED") %>%
      select(nct_id, any_psych, excl_general, excl_substance, area, phase, sponsor_class, start_year, enrollment),
    by = "nct_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(at_risk_exp > 0, at_risk_ctl > 0, !is.na(at_risk_exp), !is.na(at_risk_ctl))

print(nrow(df_harm))
print(table(df_harm$control_type, df_harm$any_psych))

# Write analysis-ready data (sheet 1 = trials, sheet 2 = harm)
write_xlsx(list(trials = df_clean, harm = df_harm), "04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx")
```

# 02. CLASSIFIER VALIDATION

## 02.1 Validation sample
```{r}
################################################################################
# 02.1 Validation sample
################################################################################

# Random sample of 200 trials, exclusion text only (no regex labels)
set.seed(1234)
val_sample <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx") %>%
  slice_sample(n = 200) %>%
  select(nct_id, exclusion_text)

if (!file.exists("04_psyexcl_validation_sample.xlsx")) {
  write_xlsx(val_sample, "04_psyexcl_validation_sample.xlsx")
}

print(nrow(val_sample))
```

## 02.2 Agreement with blind LLM labels
```{r}
################################################################################
# 02.2 Agreement with blind LLM labels
################################################################################

# Blind labels joined to regex labels
val_df <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_validation_labels.xlsx") %>%
  inner_join(read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx"), by = "nct_id")

print(nrow(val_df))

# Confusion table, any psychiatric exclusion (rows = regex, columns = LLM)
val_table <- table(regex = val_df$any_psych, llm = val_df$llm_any_psych)
print(val_table)

# Sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV
val_metrics <- tibble(
  sensitivity = val_table["1", "1"] / sum(val_table[, "1"]),
  specificity = val_table["0", "0"] / sum(val_table[, "0"]),
  ppv = val_table["1", "1"] / sum(val_table["1", ]),
  npv = val_table["0", "0"] / sum(val_table["0", ]),
  accuracy = (val_table["1", "1"] + val_table["0", "0"]) / sum(val_table)
)
print(val_metrics)

# Cohen's kappa
val_p_observed <- (val_table["1", "1"] + val_table["0", "0"]) / sum(val_table)
val_p_expected <- (sum(val_table["1", ]) * sum(val_table[, "1"]) + sum(val_table["0", ]) * sum(val_table[, "0"])) / sum(val_table)^2
print((val_p_observed - val_p_expected) / (1 - val_p_expected))

# Agreement per category
val_category_agreement <- tibble(
  category = c("general", "depression", "suicidality", "psychosis", "substance", "other"),
  agreement = c(
    mean(val_df$excl_general == val_df$llm_general),
    mean(val_df$excl_depression == val_df$llm_depression),
    mean(val_df$excl_suicidality == val_df$llm_suicidality),
    mean(val_df$excl_psychosis == val_df$llm_psychosis),
    mean(val_df$excl_substance == val_df$llm_substance),
    mean(val_df$excl_other == val_df$llm_other)
  ),
  prevalence_regex = c(
    mean(val_df$excl_general), mean(val_df$excl_depression), mean(val_df$excl_suicidality),
    mean(val_df$excl_psychosis), mean(val_df$excl_substance), mean(val_df$excl_other)
  ),
  prevalence_llm = c(
    mean(val_df$llm_general), mean(val_df$llm_depression), mean(val_df$llm_suicidality),
    mean(val_df$llm_psychosis), mean(val_df$llm_substance), mean(val_df$llm_other)
  )
)
print(val_category_agreement)

# Disagreements
print(val_df %>% filter(any_psych != llm_any_psych) %>% select(nct_id, any_psych, llm_any_psych, llm_note))
```

# H1. TIME TREND

## H1.1 Data preparation
```{r}
################################################################################
# H1.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Analysis sample
h1_df <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(
    area = factor(area, levels = c("Oncology", "Cardiovascular", "Metabolic/endocrine", "Infectious", "Respiratory", "Other")),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Phase 1/2", "Phase 2", "Phase 2/3", "Phase 3", "Phase 4")),
    sponsor_class = factor(sponsor_class, levels = c("Industry", "Government", "Other"))
  )

# Sample
print(nrow(h1_df))
print(table(h1_df$start_year))
print(mean(h1_df$any_psych))

# Proportion with any psychiatric exclusion per start year
print(h1_df %>% group_by(start_year) %>% summarise(n = n(), prop = mean(any_psych)), n = 20)
```

## H1.2 Analysis
```{r}
################################################################################
# H1.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Primary model
h1_model_primary <- glm(
  any_psych ~ start_year + area + phase + sponsor_class,
  family = binomial,
  data = h1_df
)

print(summary(h1_model_primary))
print(summary(h1_model_primary)$coefficients["start_year", ])
print(exp(coef(h1_model_primary)["start_year"]))
print(exp(confint.default(h1_model_primary)["start_year", ]))
```

## H1.3 Robustness
```{r}
################################################################################
# H1.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Completed trials only
h1_model_completed <- glm(
  any_psych ~ start_year + area + phase + sponsor_class,
  family = binomial,
  data = h1_df %>% filter(completed == 1)
)

print(summary(h1_model_completed)$coefficients["start_year", ])
print(exp(coef(h1_model_completed)["start_year"]))
print(exp(confint.default(h1_model_completed)["start_year", ]))

# Without healthy-volunteer trials
h1_model_no_hv <- glm(
  any_psych ~ start_year + area + phase + sponsor_class,
  family = binomial,
  data = h1_df %>% filter(healthy_volunteers == 0)
)

print(summary(h1_model_no_hv)$coefficients["start_year", ])
print(exp(coef(h1_model_no_hv)["start_year"]))
print(exp(confint.default(h1_model_no_hv)["start_year", ]))

# Adjusted for log enrollment
h1_model_enrollment <- glm(
  any_psych ~ start_year + area + phase + sponsor_class + log1p(enrollment),
  family = binomial,
  data = h1_df %>% filter(!is.na(enrollment))
)

print(summary(h1_model_enrollment)$coefficients["start_year", ])
print(exp(coef(h1_model_enrollment)["start_year"]))
print(exp(confint.default(h1_model_enrollment)["start_year", ]))

# Adjusted for US site
h1_model_us <- glm(
  any_psych ~ start_year + area + phase + sponsor_class + us_site,
  family = binomial,
  data = h1_df
)

print(summary(h1_model_us)$coefficients["start_year", ])
print(exp(coef(h1_model_us)["start_year"]))
print(exp(confint.default(h1_model_us)["start_year", ]))
```

# H3. THERAPEUTIC AREA

## H3.1 Data preparation
```{r}
################################################################################
# H3.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Analysis sample
h3_df <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(
    area = factor(area, levels = c("Oncology", "Cardiovascular", "Metabolic/endocrine", "Infectious", "Respiratory", "Other")),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Phase 1/2", "Phase 2", "Phase 2/3", "Phase 3", "Phase 4")),
    sponsor_class = factor(sponsor_class, levels = c("Industry", "Government", "Other"))
  )

# Sample
print(nrow(h3_df))
print(h3_df %>% group_by(area) %>% summarise(n = n(), prop = mean(any_psych)))
```

## H3.2 Analysis
```{r}
################################################################################
# H3.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Full model
h3_model_full <- glm(
  any_psych ~ area + start_year + phase + sponsor_class,
  family = binomial,
  data = h3_df
)

# Model without area
h3_model_reduced <- glm(
  any_psych ~ start_year + phase + sponsor_class,
  family = binomial,
  data = h3_df
)

print(summary(h3_model_full))

# Likelihood-ratio test of area
h3_lrt <- anova(h3_model_reduced, h3_model_full, test = "LRT")
print(h3_lrt)

# Adjusted odds ratios vs Oncology (treatment coding)
h3_model_treatment <- glm(
  any_psych ~ area + start_year + phase + sponsor_class,
  family = binomial,
  data = h3_df,
  contrasts = list(area = "contr.treatment", phase = "contr.treatment", sponsor_class = "contr.treatment")
)

print(exp(cbind(OR = coef(h3_model_treatment), confint.default(h3_model_treatment))))
```

# H4. PSYCHIATRIC HARM AND EXCLUSION (CO-PRIMARY)

## H4.1 Data preparation
```{r}
################################################################################
# H4.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Harm sample: inactive control only, at least one psychiatric event in either arm
h4_df <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx", sheet = "harm") %>%
  filter(control_type == "control_inactive") %>%
  filter(psych_max_exp + psych_max_ctl > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    area = factor(area, levels = c("Oncology", "Cardiovascular", "Metabolic/endocrine", "Infectious", "Respiratory", "Other")),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Phase 1/2", "Phase 2", "Phase 2/3", "Phase 3", "Phase 4")),
    sponsor_class = factor(sponsor_class, levels = c("Industry", "Government", "Other"))
  )

# Log risk ratio, experimental vs control
h4_df <- escalc(
  measure = "RR",
  ai = psych_max_exp, n1i = at_risk_exp,
  ci = psych_max_ctl, n2i = at_risk_ctl,
  data = h4_df
)

# Sample
print(nrow(h4_df))
print(table(h4_df$any_psych))
print(h4_df %>% group_by(any_psych) %>% summarise(
  n = n(),
  risk_exp = sum(psych_max_exp) / sum(at_risk_exp),
  risk_ctl = sum(psych_max_ctl) / sum(at_risk_ctl)
))
```

## H4.2 Analysis
```{r}
################################################################################
# H4.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Pooled psychiatric-harm RR within each group of trials
h4_model_included <- rma(yi, vi, data = h4_df %>% filter(any_psych == 0), method = "REML")
h4_model_excluded <- rma(yi, vi, data = h4_df %>% filter(any_psych == 1), method = "REML")

print(h4_model_included)
print(exp(c(h4_model_included$b, h4_model_included$ci.lb, h4_model_included$ci.ub)))
print(h4_model_excluded)
print(exp(c(h4_model_excluded$b, h4_model_excluded$ci.lb, h4_model_excluded$ci.ub)))

# Primary model: meta-regression
h4_model_primary <- rma(
  yi, vi,
  mods = ~ any_psych + area + phase + sponsor_class + start_year,
  data = h4_df,
  method = "REML"
)

print(h4_model_primary)
print(coef(summary(h4_model_primary))["any_psych", ])
print(exp(coef(h4_model_primary)["any_psych"]))
print(exp(c(h4_model_primary$ci.lb[2], h4_model_primary$ci.ub[2])))
```

## H4.3 Robustness
```{r}
################################################################################
# H4.3 Robustness
################################################################################

# Unadjusted meta-regression
h4_model_unadjusted <- rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ any_psych, data = h4_df, method = "REML")

print(coef(summary(h4_model_unadjusted))["any_psych", ])
print(exp(coef(h4_model_unadjusted)["any_psych"]))

# Sum over terms instead of max
h4_df_sum <- escalc(
  measure = "RR",
  ai = psych_sum_exp, n1i = at_risk_exp,
  ci = psych_sum_ctl, n2i = at_risk_ctl,
  data = h4_df %>%
    select(-yi, -vi) %>%
    mutate(
      psych_sum_exp = pmin(psych_sum_exp, at_risk_exp),
      psych_sum_ctl = pmin(psych_sum_ctl, at_risk_ctl)
    )
)

h4_model_sum <- rma(
  yi, vi,
  mods = ~ any_psych + area + phase + sponsor_class + start_year,
  data = h4_df_sum,
  method = "REML"
)

print(coef(summary(h4_model_sum))["any_psych", ])
print(exp(coef(h4_model_sum)["any_psych"]))

# Active comparators included
h4_df_active <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx", sheet = "harm") %>%
  filter(psych_max_exp + psych_max_ctl > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    area = factor(area, levels = c("Oncology", "Cardiovascular", "Metabolic/endocrine", "Infectious", "Respiratory", "Other")),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Phase 1/2", "Phase 2", "Phase 2/3", "Phase 3", "Phase 4")),
    sponsor_class = factor(sponsor_class, levels = c("Industry", "Government", "Other"))
  )

h4_df_active <- escalc(
  measure = "RR",
  ai = psych_max_exp, n1i = at_risk_exp,
  ci = psych_max_ctl, n2i = at_risk_ctl,
  data = h4_df_active
)

h4_model_active <- rma(
  yi, vi,
  mods = ~ any_psych + control_type + area + phase + sponsor_class + start_year,
  data = h4_df_active,
  method = "REML"
)

print(nrow(h4_df_active))
print(coef(summary(h4_model_active))["any_psych", ])
print(exp(coef(h4_model_active)["any_psych"]))

# Trials with at least 100 participants
h4_model_large <- rma(
  yi, vi,
  mods = ~ any_psych + area + phase + sponsor_class + start_year,
  data = h4_df %>% filter(at_risk_exp + at_risk_ctl >= 100),
  method = "REML"
)

print(coef(summary(h4_model_large))["any_psych", ])
print(exp(coef(h4_model_large)["any_psych"]))
```

# H7. DROP-OUT

## H7.1 Data preparation
```{r}
################################################################################
# H7.1 Data preparation
################################################################################

# Trials with plausible participant flow
h7_df <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx", sheet = "trials") %>%
  filter(!is.na(flow_started), !is.na(flow_completed), flow_started > 0, flow_completed <= flow_started) %>%
  mutate(
    area = factor(area, levels = c("Oncology", "Cardiovascular", "Metabolic/endocrine", "Infectious", "Respiratory", "Other")),
    phase = factor(phase, levels = c("Phase 1/2", "Phase 2", "Phase 2/3", "Phase 3", "Phase 4")),
    sponsor_class = factor(sponsor_class, levels = c("Industry", "Government", "Other"))
  )

# Sample
print(nrow(h7_df))
print(h7_df %>% group_by(any_psych) %>% summarise(n = n(), dropout = sum(flow_dropped) / sum(flow_started)))
```

## H7.2 Analysis
```{r}
################################################################################
# H7.2 Analysis
################################################################################

# Primary model
h7_model_primary <- glm(
  cbind(flow_dropped, flow_completed) ~ any_psych + area + phase + sponsor_class + start_year,
  family = quasibinomial,
  data = h7_df
)

print(summary(h7_model_primary))
print(summary(h7_model_primary)$coefficients["any_psych", ])
print(exp(coef(h7_model_primary)["any_psych"]))
print(exp(confint.default(h7_model_primary)["any_psych", ]))
```

# E2. BLANKET VS QUALIFIED EXCLUSIONS (EXPLORATORY)
```{r}
################################################################################
# E2. BLANKET VS QUALIFIED EXCLUSIONS (EXPLORATORY)
################################################################################

# One row per exclusion bullet in trials with a psychiatric exclusion
e2_bullets <- read_excel("04_psyexcl_clean.xlsx") %>%
  filter(any_psych == 1) %>%
  select(nct_id, exclusion_text) %>%
  mutate(exclusion_text = str_replace_all(str_to_lower(exclusion_text), pattern_false_positive, " ")) %>%
  separate_rows(exclusion_text, sep = "\n") %>%
  filter(str_detect(exclusion_text, pattern_any)) %>%
  mutate(
    qualified = str_detect(
      exclusion_text,
      "complian|comply|adheren|consent|interfere|cooperat|study requirements|study procedures|investigator|judg|opinion|unstable|uncontrolled|severe|active|current|within (the )?(last|past|previous)"
    )
  )

print(nrow(e2_bullets))
print(mean(e2_bullets$qualified))

# Trial level: every psychiatric bullet qualified vs at least one blanket bullet
e2_trials <- e2_bullets %>%
  group_by(nct_id) %>%
  summarise(all_qualified = all(qualified))

print(nrow(e2_trials))
print(mean(e2_trials$all_qualified))
```

```{r}
################################################################################

holm_df <- tibble(
  hypothesis = c("H2 sponsor_industry", "H3 area (LRT)", "H5 data gap", "H6 low accrual", "H7 drop-out"),
  p = c(
    summary(h2_model_primary)$coefficients["sponsor_industry", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    h3_lrt$`Pr(>Chi)`[2],
    summary(h5_model_primary)$coefficients["any_psych", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    summary(h6_model_primary)$coefficients["any_psych", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    summary(h7_model_primary)$coefficients["any_psych", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  )
) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

print(holm_df)
```
